briefing.headline: Nvidia reported strong third-quarter results on Tuesday, but its leadership change under interim CEO Colette Kress keeps AI stocks under pressure.

points.text: Nvidia reported Q3 fiscal 2027 revenue of $115.8 billion, up 103% from a year ago. Data Center revenue was $107.6 billion, up 110%.
points.label: reported

points.text: Nvidia's Q3 results beat expectations, and AMD, Broadcom and TSMC shares rose after the report.
points.label: reported

points.text: Jensen Huang resigned as CEO. The board says it unanimously accepted his resignation and does not intend to reinstate him.
points.label: reported

points.text: Ahead of the results, the Nasdaq and S&P 500 fell for a fourth straight session. Chip stocks sold off and the Dow dropped over 800 points on one day.
points.label: reported

points.text: Anthropic's IPO may price above its expected $70 to $78 range, according to sources. Its IPO is going ahead despite AI worries.
